```yaml
---
# Networking CLI tools role
# Tools: nmap, arp-scan, mtr, iperf3, doggo, httpie, gping, trippy, bandwhich, speedtest, rustscan

# =============================================================================
# macOS - all via Homebrew
# =============================================================================

- name: Install networking tools (macOS)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
  community.general.homebrew:
    name:
      - nmap
      - arp-scan
      - mtr
      - iperf3
      - doggo
      - httpie
      - gping
      - trippy
      - bandwhich
      - rustscan
    state: present

- name: Install Ookla Speedtest CLI (macOS)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Darwin"
  block:
    - name: Tap teamookla/speedtest
      community.general.homebrew_tap:
        name: teamookla/speedtest
        state: present

    - name: Install speedtest
      community.general.homebrew:
        name: speedtest
        state: present

# =============================================================================
# Linux (Debian/Ubuntu)
# =============================================================================

# --- apt packages (system-level) ---
- name: Install networking tools from apt (Debian/Ubuntu)
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  become: true
  tags: [sudo]
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name:
      - nmap
      - arp-scan
      - mtr
      - iperf3
      - httpie
      - tcpdump
    state: present

# --- Architecture mapping for GitHub release downloads ---
- name: Set networking tools release architecture
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    net_arch_deb: >-
      {{
        'amd64' if ansible_facts['architecture'] in ['x86_64', 'amd64']
        else 'arm64' if ansible_facts['architecture'] in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
        else ansible_facts['architecture']
      }}

# --- doggo (modern DNS lookup) ---
- name: Check if doggo is installed
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  ansible.builtin.command: doggo --version
  register: doggo_check
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Install doggo from GitHub releases (Debian/Ubuntu)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
    - doggo_check.rc != 0
  block:
    - name: Ensure ~/.local/bin exists (doggo)
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Get latest doggo release
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: https://api.github.com/repos/mr-karan/doggo/releases/latest
        return_content: true
      register: doggo_release

    - name: Set doggo version (strip v prefix)
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        doggo_version: "{{ doggo_release.json.tag_name | regex_replace('^v', '') }}"

    - name: Set doggo arch mapping
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        doggo_arch: >-
          {{
            'x86_64' if ansible_facts['architecture'] in ['x86_64', 'amd64']
            else 'arm64' if ansible_facts['architecture'] in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
            else ansible_facts['architecture']
          }}

    - name: Download doggo tarball
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/mr-karan/doggo/releases/download/{{ doggo_release.json.tag_name }}/doggo_{{ doggo_version }}_Linux_{{ doggo_arch }}.tar.gz"
        dest: /tmp/doggo.tar.gz
        mode: '0644'

    - name: Extract doggo
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: /tmp/doggo.tar.gz
        dest: /tmp
        remote_src: true

    - name: Install doggo to ~/.local/bin
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: /tmp/doggo
        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/doggo"
        mode: '0755'
        remote_src: true

    - name: Clean up doggo temp files
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ item }}"
        state: absent
      loop:
        - /tmp/doggo.tar.gz
        - /tmp/doggo
        - /tmp/LICENSE
        - /tmp/README.md

# --- gping (graphical ping) ---
- name: Check if gping is installed
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  ansible.builtin.command: gping --version
  register: gping_check
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Install gping from GitHub releases (Debian/Ubuntu)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
    - gping_check.rc != 0
  block:
    - name: Ensure ~/.local/bin exists (gping)
      ansible.builtin.file:

        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Set gping arch mapping
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        gping_arch: >-
          {{
            'x86_64' if ansible_facts['architecture'] in ['x86_64', 'amd64']
            else 'arm64' if ansible_facts['architecture'] in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
            else ansible_facts['architecture']
          }}

    - name: Get latest gping release
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: https://api.github.com/repos/orf/gping/releases/latest
        return_content: true
      register: gping_release

    - name: Download gping tarball
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/orf/gping/releases/download/{{ gping_release.json.tag_name }}/gping-Linux-musl-{{ gping_arch }}.tar.gz"
        dest: /tmp/gping.tar.gz
        mode: '0644'

    - name: Extract gping to ~/.local/bin
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: /tmp/gping.tar.gz
        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"

    - name: Clean up gping tarball
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /tmp/gping.tar.gz
        state: absent

# --- trippy (TUI traceroute) ---
- name: Check if trippy is installed
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  ansible.builtin.command: trip --version
  register: trippy_check
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Install trippy from GitHub releases (Debian/Ubuntu, system-level)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
    - trippy_check.rc != 0
  become: true
  tags: [sudo]
  block:
    - name: Get latest trippy release
      ansible.builtin.uri:
        url: https://api.github.com/repos/fujiapple852/trippy/releases/latest
        return_content: true
      register: trippy_release

    - name: Download trippy .deb package
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/fujiapple852/trippy/releases/download/{{ trippy_release.json.tag_name }}/trippy-{{ trippy_release.json.tag_name }}-{{ ansible_facts['architecture'] }}-unknown-linux-gnu.deb"
        dest: /tmp/trippy.deb
        mode: '0644'

    - name: Install trippy .deb package
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        deb: /tmp/trippy.deb

    - name: Clean up trippy .deb
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: /tmp/trippy.deb
        state: absent

# --- trippy (user-level fallback) ---
- name: Re-check if trippy is installed
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  ansible.builtin.shell: command -v trip
  register: trippy_recheck
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Install trippy from GitHub releases (user-level, no sudo)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
    - trippy_recheck.rc != 0
  block:
    - name: Ensure ~/.local/bin exists (trippy)

    - name: Get latest trippy release (user)

        dest: /tmp/trippy.tar.gz
        mode: '0644'

    - name: Extract trippy (user)
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: /tmp/trippy.tar.gz
        dest: /tmp
        remote_src: true

    - name: Install trip to ~/.local/bin

        dest: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/trip"

    - name: Clean up trippy temp files (user)
      ansible.builtin.file:

        state: absent
      loop:

        - "/tmp/trippy-{{ trippy_release_user.json.tag_name }}-{{ ansible_facts['architecture'] }}-unknown-linux-musl"

  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"

- name: Install bandwhich from GitHub releases (Debian/Ubuntu)

    - name: Ensure ~/.local/bin exists (bandwhich)

# --- rustscan (fast port scanner) ---
- name: Check if rustscan is installed
  when: ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
  ansible.builtin.command: rustscan --version
  register: rustscan_check
  changed_when: false
  failed_when: false

- name: Install rustscan from GitHub releases (Debian/Ubuntu)
  when:
    - ansible_facts["os_family"] == "Debian"
    - rustscan_check.rc != 0
  block:
    - name: Ensure ~/.local/bin exists (rustscan)
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Set rustscan arch mapping
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        rustscan_arch: >-
          {{
            'x86_64' if ansible_facts['architecture'] in ['x86_64', 'amd64']
            else 'aarch64' if ansible_facts['architecture'] in ['aarch64', 'arm64']
            else ansible_facts['architecture']
          }}

    - name: Download rustscan archive (x86_64)
      when: rustscan_arch == 'x86_64'
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/RustScan/RustScan/releases/latest/download/x86_64-linux-rustscan.tar.gz.zip"
        dest: /tmp/rustscan.zip
        mode: '0644'

    - name: Download rustscan archive (aarch64)
      when: rustscan_arch == 'aarch64'
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "https://github.com/RustScan/RustScan/releases/latest/download/aarch64-linux-rustscan.zip"
        dest: /tmp/rustscan.zip
        mode: '0644'

    - name: Extract and install rustscan (x86_64 - double wrapped)
      when: rustscan_arch == 'x86_64'
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        set -e
        cd /tmp
        python3 -m zipfile -e rustscan.zip .
        tar xzf x86_64-linux-rustscan.tar.gz
        cp rustscan "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/rustscan"
        chmod 0755 "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/rustscan"
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      changed_when: true

    - name: Extract and install rustscan (aarch64)
      when: rustscan_arch == 'aarch64'
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        set -e
        cd /tmp
        python3 -m zipfile -e rustscan.zip .
        cp rustscan "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/rustscan"
        chmod 0755 "{{ ansible_facts['env']['HOME'] }}/.local/bin/rustscan"
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      changed_when: true

    - name: Clean up rustscan temp files
      ansible.builtin.shell: |
        rm -f /tmp/rustscan.zip /tmp/rustscan /tmp/x86_64-linux-rustscan.tar.gz /tmp/aarch64-linux-rustscan
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      changed_when: false

```zsh
# 50_networking.zsh - Networking tool aliases and helpers

# --- Listening ports (works everywhere, no extra install needed) ---
alias ports='lsof -i -P -n | grep LISTEN'

# --- IP address helpers ---
alias myip='curl -s https://ifconfig.me'
if [[ "$OSTYPE" == darwin* ]]; then
  alias localip='ipconfig getifaddr en0'
else
  alias localip='hostname -I | awk "{print \$1}"'
fi

# --- nmap shortcuts ---
if command -v nmap &>/dev/null; then
  # Quick ping sweep of local /24 subnet
  pingsweep() {
    local ip
    if [[ "$OSTYPE" == darwin* ]]; then
      ip=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null)
    else
      ip=$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
    fi
    local base="${ip%.*}.0/24"
    echo "Scanning $base ..."
    nmap -sn "$base"
  }
fi

# --- arp-scan ---
if command -v arp-scan &>/dev/null; then
  alias arpscan='sudo arp-scan -l'
fi

# --- doggo (modern DNS lookup with DoH/DoT/DoQ) ---
if command -v doggo &>/dev/null; then
  alias dns='doggo'
fi

# --- gping (graphical ping) ---
# gping is already short enough, no alias needed

# --- trippy (TUI traceroute, binary is 'trip') ---
# trip is already short enough, no alias needed

# --- bandwhich (bandwidth monitor, needs sudo for packet capture) ---
if command -v bandwhich &>/dev/null; then
  alias bw-net='sudo bandwhich'
fi

# --- rustscan (fast port scanner -> nmap) ---
if command -v rustscan &>/dev/null; then
  alias portscan='rustscan'
fi

# --- speedtest (Ookla CLI) ---
# speedtest is already short enough, no alias needed

```

# Networking CLI Tools

Optional role (`installNetworkingTools`). Install via `chezmoi init --force` and enable the prompt.

## Tools

| Tool | Binary | Purpose | Sudo at runtime? |
|------|--------|---------|-------------------|
| [nmap](https://nmap.org/) | `nmap` | Port scanning, host discovery, OS detection, service enumeration | Some features (OS detection, SYN scan) |
| [arp-scan](https://github.com/royhills/arp-scan) | `arp-scan` | Fast Layer 2 host discovery with OUI vendor lookup | Yes (raw sockets) |
| [mtr](https://www.bitwizard.nl/mtr/) | `mtr` | Real-time combined ping + traceroute | Some modes |
| [iperf3](https://iperf.fr/) | `iperf3` | Network bandwidth/throughput testing between two hosts | No |
| [doggo](https://github.com/mr-karan/doggo) | `doggo` | Modern DNS lookup (replaces dig/nslookup), DoH/DoT/DoQ | No |
| [HTTPie](https://httpie.io/) | `http` / `https` | Modern HTTP client, nicer than curl for API testing | No |
| [gping](https://github.com/orf/gping) | `gping` | Ping with a real-time graph | No |
| [trippy](https://github.com/fujiapple852/trippy) | `trip` | Modern TUI traceroute with rich visualization | Yes (raw sockets) |
| [bandwhich](https://github.com/imsnif/bandwhich) | `bandwhich` | Terminal bandwidth utilization per process/connection | Yes (packet capture) |
| [Ookla Speedtest](https://www.speedtest.net/apps/cli) | `speedtest` | Official Ookla internet speed test | No |
| [RustScan](https://github.com/RustScan/RustScan) | `rustscan` | Fast port scanner, feeds results into nmap | No |

## Shell Aliases

Defined in `~/.config/zsh/tools/50_networking.zsh`:

| Alias | Command | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `ports` | `lsof -i -P -n \| grep LISTEN` | Show all listening ports |
| `myip` | `curl -s https://ifconfig.me` | Show public IP address |
| `localip` | platform-aware | Show local LAN IP address |
| `arpscan` | `sudo arp-scan -l` | Scan local network (Layer 2) |
| `pingsweep` | `nmap -sn <subnet>/24` | Ping sweep local /24 subnet (function) |
| `dns` | `doggo` | DNS lookup shortcut |
| `bw-net` | `sudo bandwhich` | Bandwidth monitor (avoids conflict with `bw` = Bitwarden) |
| `portscan` | `rustscan` | Fast port scan shortcut |

## Common Usage

### What's on my network?

\```bash
# Layer 2 ARP scan (most reliable, shows MAC + vendor)
arpscan

# Ping sweep (Layer 3)
pingsweep

# Full scan with OS detection
sudo nmap -sV -O 192.168.1.0/24
\```

### Port scanning

\```bash
# Quick port scan (rustscan is ~10x faster than nmap alone)
portscan -a 192.168.1.100

# Specific ports with nmap
nmap -p 22,80,443,8080 192.168.1.100

# Service version detection
nmap -sV -p 22,80 192.168.1.100
\```

### DNS lookup

\```bash
# Basic lookup
dns example.com

# Specific record type
dns example.com MX
dns example.com AAAA

# Use DNS-over-HTTPS
dns example.com --class IN --type A @https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query

# Use DNS-over-TLS
dns example.com @tls://1.1.1.1
\```

### Diagnostics

\```bash
# Real-time traceroute
mtr google.com

# Graphical ping (compare multiple hosts)
gping google.com cloudflare.com 1.1.1.1

# TUI traceroute with rich visualization
trip google.com

# See what's listening on this machine
ports
\```

### Bandwidth testing

\```bash
# Internet speed test
speedtest

# LAN throughput (need iperf3 on both ends)
# On server: iperf3 -s
# On client:  iperf3 -c <server-ip>

# Monitor per-process bandwidth usage
bw-net
\```

### HTTP testing

\```bash
# GET request (httpie)
http httpbin.org/get

# POST with JSON
http POST httpbin.org/post name=test value=123

# With headers
http GET api.example.com Authorization:"Bearer token123"
\```

## Platform Notes

- **macOS**: All tools installed via Homebrew. `tcpdump` is preinstalled.
- **Linux (with sudo)**: `nmap`, `arp-scan`, `mtr`, `iperf3`, `httpie`, `tcpdump` via apt. Others from GitHub releases to `~/.local/bin`.
- **Linux (noRoot)**: apt tools skipped; `trippy` system-level install skipped. GitHub binary tools still work but `arp-scan`, `bandwhich`, and `trippy` need sudo at runtime for raw socket access.

51	## Quick Setup
52	
53	```bash
54	# One-liner to initialize and apply (installs chezmoi to ~/.local/bin)
55	export GITHUB_USERNAME=daviddwlee84
56	sh -c "$(curl -fsLS get.chezmoi.io)" -- -b "$HOME/.local/bin" init --apply git@github.com:$GITHUB_USERNAME/dotfiles.git
57	```
58	
59	This automatically:
60	
61	1. Bootstraps Homebrew (macOS/Linux), uv, mise, ansible
62	2. Deploys all config files
63	3. Runs ansible playbooks (git, ripgrep, fd, neovim, etc.)
64	4. Runs brew bundle (if `installBrewApps` enabled)
65	
66	### Optional Components
67	
68	During `chezmoi init`, you'll be prompted for optional installs:
69	
70	| Option | Default | Description |
71	|--------|---------|-------------|
72	| `installCodingAgents` | true | Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, td, sidecar, specify-cli, etc. |
73	| `installBitwarden` | false | Bitwarden CLI (`bw`) + Desktop app (desktop profiles) with SSH agent auto-detection |
74	| `installPythonUvTools` | true | Python CLI tools via uv (mlflow, litellm, sqlit-tui, etc.) |
75	| `installBrewApps` | false | GUI apps via Homebrew Brewfile (casks, mas) |
76	| `installInputMethod` | false | Traditional Chinese input methods (McBopomofo, RIME/Squirrel on macOS; ibus-rime on Linux) |
77	| `noRoot` | false | Skip sudo-requiring tasks (for servers without root access) |
78	
79	To change options later: `chezmoi init --force`
80	
81	## What You Get
82	
83	### Config Files
84	
85	- `~/.gitconfig` - Git configuration
86	- `~/.config/nvim/` - Neovim (LazyVim) configuration
87	- `~/.config/uv/uv.toml` - uv package manager config
88	- `~/.cargo/config.toml` - Cargo registry mirror config (GFW)
89	- `~/.npmrc` - npm registry config (official/npmmirror via `useChineseMirror`)
90	- `~/.config/.bunfig.toml` - Bun global registry config (official/npmmirror via `useChineseMirror`)
91	- `~/.config/alacritty/` - Alacritty terminal config
92	- `~/.config/starship.toml` - Starship cross-shell prompt config
93	- `~/.config/direnv/direnvrc` - direnv helper functions, including `.venv`-aware Python activation
94	- `~/.config/yazi/` - Yazi file manager config (v0.3.3+ syntax, [docs](https://yazi-rs.github.io/docs/configuration/overview/))
95	  - `yazi.toml` - Main config with open rules and openers (`o`/`O`)
96	  - `keymap.toml`, `theme.toml` - Optional customization files (stubs provided)
97	- `~/.claude/` - Claude Code settings
98	- `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml` - Global SpecStory defaults for `specstory run` across all projects
99	- `~/.tmux.conf` - Tmux configuration with TPM plugins
100	- `~/.local/bin/x` - Cross-platform terminal wrapper for `copy` / `paste` / `open`
101	- `~/.config/zsh/tools/22_sesh.zsh` - Sesh keybinding (Ctrl+A for tmux session switcher)
102	- `~/.config/zsh/tools/36_pueue.zsh` - Pueue queue summary helper (`pqsum`)
103	- `~/.config/zsh/tools/28_tldr.zsh` - `tldrf` helper with `TLDR_LANGUAGES` fallback order
104	- `~/.config/zsh/tools/95_bitwarden.zsh` - Bitwarden CLI completion + SSH agent socket auto-detection
105	- `~/.ssh/config` - SSH main config skeleton (create-only: `Include ~/.ssh/config.d/*` + conservative `Host *` defaults)
106	- `~/.ssh/config.d/00-defaults` - SSH global defaults stub (commented examples only)
107	- `~/.ssh/config.d/git` - SSH host entries for `github.com` and `gitlab.com` with commented multi-account/Bitwarden examples
108	- `~/.config/tmuxp/claude-sidecar.yaml` - tmuxp workspace for Claude + Sidecar
109	- `~/.config/zellij/layouts/claude-sidecar.kdl` - Zellij layout for Claude + Sidecar
110	- `~/.config/homebrew/` - Brewfiles for GUI apps (macOS casks + mas) plus selected CLI formulas (e.g., `tailscale`)
111	
112	SSH files are managed as create-only templates: if `~/.ssh/config` already exists, it is not overwritten. In that case, add `Include ~/.ssh/config.d/*` to your existing config manually to load the managed snippets.
113	
114	### Tools (via ansible)
115	
116	- **Base**: git, curl, ripgrep, fd, just, build tools
117	- **Neovim**: >= 0.11.2 with LazyVim dependencies
118	- **LazyVim deps**: fzf, lazygit, tree-sitter-cli, Node.js
119	- **DuckDB CLI**: `duckdb` (Homebrew on macOS, official installer on Linux)
120	- **rclone**: cloud storage sync CLI (Homebrew on macOS, official downloads on Linux)
121	- **Coding Agents** (optional): Claude Code, Codex CLI, CodexBar, OpenCode, Cursor CLI, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, SpecStory, OpenChamber, td, sidecar, specify-cli
122	- **Bitwarden** (optional): Bitwarden CLI (`bw`) via npm, Desktop app (snap/deb on Linux, cask on macOS) on desktop profiles, with zsh completion and SSH agent auto-detection
123	- **Input Methods** (optional): McBopomofo + RIME (Squirrel on macOS, ibus-rime on Linux)
124	- **Docker**: OrbStack (macOS) or Docker Engine (Linux)
125	- **Cargo tools**: pueue (process queue manager)
126	- **GUI Apps** (macOS): terminals, editors, browsers, network tools, utilities via Brewfile (Tailscale Desktop via Mac App Store `mas`, avoids pkg sudo prompt; Tailscale CLI via `brew "tailscale"` in shared Brewfile)
127	
128	### Bootstrap (installed before ansible)
129	- **Homebrew** (macOS): Package manager for macOS
130	- **uv**: Python package manager for ansible
131	- **mise**: Runtime manager for Node.js and Rust (ensures latest versions)
132	- **Dev tools**: bat, eza, git-delta, git-graph, tldr, thefuck, zoxide, direnv, yazi, tmux+tpm, sesh, zellij, btop, htop
133	- **Starship**: Cross-shell prompt (replaces oh-my-zsh theme)
134	- **Python tools (via uv)**: thefuck, apprise, sqlit-tui, dotenv, git-filter-repo, mlflow, litellm, tmuxp
135	- **NerdFonts**: Hack Nerd Font for terminal emulators
136	
137	## Supported Platforms
138	
139	| Platform | Package Manager | Notes |
140	|----------|-----------------|-------|
141	| macOS | Homebrew | Full support |
142	| Ubuntu Desktop | apt + snap | Full support |
143	| Ubuntu Server | apt + snap | Full support |
144	| Ubuntu Server (no root) | GitHub binaries + mise + cargo + uv | `noRoot=true`, tools installed to `~/.local/bin` |
145	
146	## Manual Commands
147	
148	```bash
149	chezmoi diff          # Preview changes
150	chezmoi apply         # Apply config files
151	chezmoi cd            # Go to source directory
152	
153	# Re-run ansible manually
154	cd ~/.ansible && ansible-playbook playbooks/macos.yml
155	```
156	
157	## Docker Testing
158	
159	Test the full dotfiles setup on a bare Ubuntu machine:

161	```bash
162	# Build and run test suite
163	just docker-test
164	
165	# Interactive devbox shell
166	just docker-run
167	
168	# Build specific profiles
169	just docker-desktop    # Ubuntu desktop profile
170	just docker-china      # China mirror profile
171	```
172	
173	## Development with justfile
174	
175	This project uses [just](https://github.com/casey/just) as a command runner:
176	
177	```bash
178	just                  # List all commands
179	just lint             # Ansible syntax check
180	just check            # Full lint + dry-run
181	just docker-build     # Build Docker image
182	just info             # Show system info
183	```
184	
185	## Customization
186	
187	See [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md) for development guide, [docs/ansible.md](docs/ansible.md) for ansible customization, [docs/tools/direnv.md](docs/tools/direnv.md) for `.venv`-aware direnv usage, [docs/tools/specstory.md](docs/tools/specstory.md) for SpecStory configuration, [docs/tools/td_sidecar.md](docs/tools/td_sidecar.md) for td/sidecar usage, and [docs/tools/specify_cli.md](docs/tools/specify_cli.md) for Specify CLI.

```text
55	├── dot_ansible/              → ~/.ansible/ (ansible playbooks)
56	├── run_once_before_*.tmpl    → bootstrap (runs once)
57	└── run_onchange_after_*.tmpl → ansible (runs on changes)
58	```
59	
60	Installation Order:
61	
62	```
63	1. Bootstrap (run_once_before) - installs Homebrew (macOS/Linux), uv, ansible, mise
64	2. chezmoi apply - deploys config files + ansible playbooks
65	3. Ansible (run_onchange_after) - runs on fresh install + when roles change
66	4. Brew bundle (run_onchange_after) - installs GUI apps if enabled
67	```
68	
69	### Auto-run Scripts
70	
71	| Script | Behavior |
72	|--------|----------|
73	| `run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl` | Installs Homebrew (macOS and Linux), uv, mise, ansible |
74	| `run_onchange_after_20_ansible_roles.sh.tmpl` | Runs ansible with all tags |
75	| `run_onchange_after_30_brew_bundle.sh.tmpl` | Runs brew bundle (if `installBrewApps` enabled) |
76	
77	The onchange script includes SHA256 hashes of all role files. It runs:
78	
79	- **Fresh install**: no previous hash state → triggers run
80	- **Updates**: any role's `tasks/main.yml` or `defaults/main.yml` changes → triggers run
81	
82	To force re-run all scripts:
83	
84	```bash
85	chezmoi state delete-bucket --bucket=scriptState
86	chezmoi apply
87	```
88	
89	## Chezmoi Commands
90	
91	```bash
92	chezmoi diff              # Preview changes
93	chezmoi apply             # Apply changes
94	chezmoi apply --dry-run   # Test without applying
```

```text
1	# Ansible Customization Guide
2	
3	This document explains how to customize the ansible setup for your dotfiles.
4	
5	## Directory Structure
6	
7	After `chezmoi apply`, ansible files are deployed to `~/.ansible/`:
8	
9	```
10	~/.ansible/
11	├── ansible.cfg            # Ansible configuration (sets roles_path, inventory)
12	├── inventories/
13	│   └── localhost.ini      # Local inventory
14	├── playbooks/
15	│   ├── base.yml           # Cross-platform essentials
16	│   ├── linux.yml          # Linux-specific setup
17	│   └── macos.yml          # macOS-specific setup
18	└── roles/
19	    ├── base/              # git, curl, ripgrep, fd, etc.
20	    ├── homebrew/          # macOS Homebrew installation
21	    ├── neovim/            # Neovim with version check
22	    └── lazyvim_deps/      # fzf, lazygit, tree-sitter-cli
23	```
24	
25	## Prerequisites
26	
27	Install ansible and required collections:
28	
29	```bash
30	# Install ansible with uv
31	uv tool install ansible-core
32	
33	# Install community.general collection (for homebrew module)
34	ansible-galaxy collection install community.general
35	```
36	
37	## Running Playbooks
38	
39	Run from `~/.ansible/` directory (ansible.cfg sets inventory and roles_path automatically):
40	
41	### Full Setup
42	
43	```bash
44	cd ~/.ansible
45	
46	# macOS
47	ansible-playbook playbooks/macos.yml
48	
49	# Linux
50	ansible-playbook playbooks/linux.yml
51	```
52	
53	### Specific Tags
54	
55	```bash
56	cd ~/.ansible
57	
58	# Only install neovim
59	ansible-playbook playbooks/macos.yml --tags neovim
60	
61	# Install neovim and its dependencies
62	ansible-playbook playbooks/macos.yml --tags "neovim,lazyvim_deps"
63	```
64	
65	### Skip Tags
66	
67	```bash
68	# Skip tasks requiring sudo (for non-admin users)
69	ansible-playbook playbooks/linux.yml --skip-tags sudo
70	```
71	
72	### Dry Run
73	
74	```bash
75	# Check what would change without applying
76	ansible-playbook playbooks/macos.yml --check
77	
78	# Verbose output
79	ansible-playbook playbooks/macos.yml --check -v
80	```
81	
82	## Available Tags
83	
84	| Tag | Description | Requires Sudo |
85	|-----|-------------|---------------|
86	| `base` | Essential tools (git, curl, ripgrep, fd, jq) | Linux only |
87	| `homebrew` | macOS Homebrew installation | No |
88	| `neovim` | Neovim installation with version check | Linux only |
89	| `lazyvim_deps` | LazyVim dependencies | Linux only |
90	| `sudo` | All tasks requiring elevated privileges | Yes |
91	
92	## Adding New Roles
93	
94	1. Create role directory structure:
95	
96	```bash
97	mkdir -p ~/.ansible/roles/myrole/tasks
98	mkdir -p ~/.ansible/roles/myrole/defaults  # optional
99	```
100	
101	2. Create tasks file `~/.ansible/roles/myrole/tasks/main.yml`:
102	
103	```yaml
104	---
105	- name: Install my package (macOS)
106	  when: ansible_os_family == "Darwin"
107	  community.general.homebrew:
108	    name: mypackage
109	    state: present
110	
111	- name: Install my package (Debian/Ubuntu)
112	  when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"
113	  become: true
114	  tags: [sudo]
115	  ansible.builtin.apt:
116	    name: mypackage
117	    state: present
118	```
119	
120	3. Add role to playbook:
121	
122	```yaml
123	# In ~/.ansible/playbooks/macos.yml or linux.yml
124	roles:
125	  - role: myrole
126	    tags: [myrole]
127	```
128	
129	## Syncing Changes Back to Chezmoi
130	
131	After experimenting with changes in `~/.ansible/`, add them back to chezmoi:
132	
133	```bash
134	# Copy modified files back to chezmoi source
135	cp ~/.ansible/roles/myrole/tasks/main.yml ~/.local/share/chezmoi/dot_ansible/roles/myrole/tasks/main.yml
136	
137	# Or use chezmoi re-add
138	chezmoi re-add ~/.ansible/roles/myrole/tasks/main.yml
139	```
140	
141	## OS Detection
142	
143	Ansible facts used for OS detection:
144	
145	| Fact | macOS | Ubuntu/Debian |
146	|------|-------|---------------|
147	| `ansible_os_family` | Darwin | Debian |
148	| `ansible_distribution` | MacOSX | Ubuntu |
149	| `ansible_pkg_mgr` | homebrew | apt |
150	
151	Example conditional:
152	
153	```yaml
154	- name: macOS only task
155	  when: ansible_os_family == "Darwin"
156	  # ...
157	
158	- name: Ubuntu only task
159	  when: ansible_distribution == "Ubuntu"
160	  # ...
161	```
162	
163	## Sudo Handling
164	
165	### Linux
166	
167	Most package installations require sudo. Tasks are tagged with `sudo`:
168	
169	```yaml
170	- name: Install package
171	  become: true
172	  tags: [sudo]
173	  ansible.builtin.apt:
174	    name: mypackage
175	```
176	
177	Skip these with `--skip-tags sudo` if you don't have sudo access.
178	
179	### macOS
180	
181	Homebrew runs as user, no sudo needed. The only exception is system-level changes.
182	
183	## Troubleshooting
184	
185	### Syntax Check
186	
187	```bash
188	ansible-playbook --syntax-check ~/.ansible/playbooks/base.yml
189	```
190	
191	### Verbose Output
192	
193	```bash
194	ansible-playbook ... -vvv
195	```
196	
197	### List Tasks
198	
199	```bash
200	ansible-playbook ... --list-tasks
201	```
202	
203	### List Tags
204	
205	```bash
206	ansible-playbook ... --list-tags
207	```
208	
209	## LazyVim Requirements
210	
211	LazyVim needs:
212	
213	- Neovim >= 0.11.2
214	- ripgrep (for telescope live grep)
215	- fd (for telescope file finder)
216	- Node.js (for LSP servers)
217	- tree-sitter-cli (for syntax highlighting)
218	- lazygit (optional, for git integration)
219	- fzf (optional, for fuzzy finding)
220	
221	All are installed by the `base`, `neovim`, and `lazyvim_deps` roles.
222
```
</details></tool-use>
